headline: Avramar Commercial: growth with pressure on profitability
summary: Avramar Commercial is dynamically increasing its sales. Exchange rates and financial costs are pressuring profitability and changing its risk balance.
why: Company profitability depends on sales growth, currency exposure, and financing costs. Exchange-rate and interest-expense pressures can narrow margins even as revenue rises.
